description: Georgia O'Keeffe, Quida Ball and Mike Harding walking down Clear Creek after viewing the Cathedral of the Desert. This photograph is part of the Glen Canyon Album that Todd Webb gave to Georgia O'Keeffe 'in memory of the great August 1961 trip down the Colorado River'.
title: Georgia O'Keeffe, Quida Ball and Mike Harding Walking Down Clear Creek
